newsitem.title: UK: Seagate to double size of N.Ireland plant.
newsitem.headline: Seagate to double size of N.Ireland plant.

text.p: Seagate Technology Inc is to invest a further 149 million sterling to more than double the size of its Londonderry plant and create 1,125 more jobs, the British government said on Friday.
It said the U.S.-based company is to carry out the fourth major expansion of its Londonderry plant since it opened up in Northern Ireland's second city in March 1993.

"I am delighted that Seagate, a $9.0 billion global leader in computer data storage technology has chosen to build a new 290,000 square foot fabrication plant here in Derry," Minister of State Adam Ingram said in a statement.

"Seagate's growth is a stunning story and a tremendous endorsement of Northern Ireland as a world class base for the development and manufacture of advanced technology components for the electronics industry," he said.
The expansion is backed by the government's Industrial Development Board, a state investment agency which is seeking to attract further hi-tech investment in the British province.

Job creation is seen by successive British governments as a key to bringing a peaceful atmosphere to the province, which has suffered a 28-year political and sectarian conflict which has killed 3,200.
